app.name: uProVid
app.subtitle: Your YouTube, your tweaks: base IPA + the mods you pick
app.description: uProVid is a build-it-yourself YouTube mod. Bring your own decrypted YouTube base IPA (local file or link), pick the tweaks you want - YouMod and YTLite resolve from their official upstream releases, anything else by direct .deb link - set the app name, bundle ID and version, and the Tweak Factory injects the selection with Cyan and publishes the result back to this source as a provenance-tagged release with digests. Until the first uProVid factory build ships (tag tweak-build/uprovid/* in this repository), the listing serves ASJTube 1.2.1 on YouTube 21.37.4 - the same publisher's ready-to-sideload YouTube enhancer with the YouPip / YouQuality / dislikes/privacy tweak stack - as a stand-in. Build one: python3 scripts/tweak_factory.py build (docs/TWEAK-FACTORY.md). Requires iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
